tooth_brushing.title: Brush teeth
tooth_brushing.intro: Your pup's breed needs its teeth brushed. Brush gently with a dog toothbrush — never use human toothpaste.
tooth_brushing.stageA11y: Your pup's mouth. Swipe to brush its teeth.
tooth_brushing.success: Well done — clean teeth help keep your pup healthy.

fold_cleaning.title: Wipe the folds
fold_cleaning.intro: Your pup's breed has skin folds that need gentle cleaning. Wipe softly with a damp cloth, then pat dry.
fold_cleaning.stageA11y: Your pup's face. Swipe to wipe the folds.
fold_cleaning.success: Well done — clean, dry folds keep the skin happy.

ear_cleaning.title: Clean the ears
ear_cleaning.chipA11y: Check and clean your pup's ears.
ear_cleaning.intro: Your pup's breed needs its ears checked and cleaned. Look inside, then wipe only the outer ear gently — never push anything into the ear.
ear_cleaning.stageA11y: Your pup's ears. Swipe to clean them.
ear_cleaning.success: Well done — you checked and cleaned both ears.

nail_trim.title: Trim the nails
nail_trim.intro: Your pup's breed needs its nails trimmed. In real life a grown-up helps: only the very tip, never the pink part.
nail_trim.stageA11y: Your pup's front paws. Tap each claw.
nail_trim.success: Well done — short nails make walking comfortable.
